mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle industrial production growth above 1.5% year-over-year intensifies supply chain pressures, compressing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth > 1.5% YoY, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
